title: Faith Communities and DFV Prevention
description: This module supports faith leaders and community members to understand and respond to DFV in ways that are safe, ethical, and aligned with trauma-informed practice. It focuses on recognising harmful interpretations, supporting survivors, and building safe faith environments.
outcomes: Recognise how DFV can be hidden or minimised within faith contexts
Respond safely and ethically to disclosures within faith communities
Promote faith environments that support safety, dignity, and equality
